<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 31a:8">R. Hash. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>שיתא אלפי שני הוי ע׳ וכ׳</he> the world shall last six thousand years, and one thousand years it will be waste.

<cite ref="Gittin 56b:10">Gitt. 56ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="H01807"><he>חֲשֵׁב</he></cite>; a. v. fr.—Midr. Sam. ch. XXIV; Yalk. ib. 139 <he>ע׳ דשקר</he> the world of falsehood (this world); <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 26:9">Lev. R. s. 26</cite> (some ed. <he>עולם</he>, h. form); <he>ע׳ דקושטא</he> the world of truth (the hereafter).
Sot. 10ᵇ, a. fr. ע׳ דאתי the world to come (= h. עולם הבא).—בית ע׳ the house of eternity (euphem. for ‘the house of death’) burial ground, cemetery.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 12:5">Lev. R. s. 12</cite>, beg.; a. e.—

<cite ref="Kiddushin 80b:14">Kidd. 80ᵇ</cite> <he>אינשי דע׳</he> common people (opp. to scholars).—<he>כל ע׳</he>, <he>כולי ע׳</he> (abbrev. <he>כ״ע</he>), v. <cite ref="K00262"><he>כּוֹלָּא</he></cite>.
Ber. 36ᵇ כ״ע לא פליגי all the authorities mentioned agree; a. v. fr.—בְּעַלְמָא in a general way, merely.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 26:24">Targ. Y. Lev. XXVI, 24</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 26:28">28</cite>.—

<cite ref="Shabbat 9b:2">Ib. 9ᵇ</cite> <he>להזיע בע׳</he> merely to sweat (not to bathe); <he>לעיוני בע׳</he> merely to examine (not to do any labor); a. v. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="P00827"><he>עָלְמִין</he></cite>, <he>עָלְמַיָּיא</he>; constr. <he>עָלְמֵי</he>.
